pricing.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pricing.faq.subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers.
pricing.faq.q1.question: How does the AI matching work?
pricing.faq.q1.answer: Our AI analyzes your academic background, interests, achievements, and goals to find scholarships that best match your profile. The more information you provide, the more accurate the matches become.
pricing.faq.q2.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing.faq.q2.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. Your premium features will remain active until the end of your current billing period.
pricing.faq.q3.question: Is there a free trial for premium plans?
pricing.faq.q3.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial for our Premium plan. No credit card required to start.
pricing.faq.q4.question: What happens if I don't get accepted to any scholarships?
pricing.faq.q4.answer: Our Pro plan includes a success guarantee. If you follow our recommendations and don't receive any scholarship offers within 6 months, we'll provide additional support or a partial refund.
pricing.faq.q5.question: Do you offer student discounts?
pricing.faq.q5.answer: Yes, we offer additional discounts for students from underrepresented backgrounds. Contact our support team to learn more about available programs.
